{{Tabs|History = No}} {{For|[[Humvee]]|[[Humvee 3]]}} {{UnitInfobox |title1 = Humvee 2 |image-static = DefaultHumvee2.png |image-dynamic = Humvee2Dynamic.png |pseudoxd = true |source = [[Military Base]] |type = Vehicle |spawnrate = [[File:VehicleSpawn.png|20px|Spawnrate]]35s |health = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]100 |damage_type = Collsion |ranged_range = [[File:Range Icon.png|20px|Range]]5 |speed = 8 |hidden = No |lead = {{Attr|Lead|Yes}} |flying = No |pvp_spawnrate = [[File:VehicleSpawn.png|20px|Spawnrate]]25s |pvp_health = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]100 |pvp_damage_type = Collsion |pvp_ranged_range = [[File:Range Icon.png|20px|Range]]5 |pvp_speed = 6 |pvp_hidden = No |pvp_lead = {{Attr|Lead|Yes}} |pvp_flying = No }} __TOC__ == Description == The '''Humvee 2''' ('''High Mobility Multipurpose Wheeled Vehicle Version 2''') is the second vehicle that spawns from the [[Military Base]]. In-game, it is referred to as just ''Humvee'', though it has been referenced here as '''Humvee 2''' to differentiate itself from other [[Military Base]] units. It spawns when the [[Military Base]] is at Level 2. As with other [[units]], it starts from the end of the map path and moves towards the entrance of the map. The '''Humvee 2''' has a spawnrate of 35 seconds, but in [[PVP]] mode this is reduced down to 25 seconds. There is a limit of three units per [[Military Base]], limiting the amount of '''Humvee 2s''' that can spawn. This however generally should not be an issue, due to how hard it is to reach this limit. ==Appearance== The current version of the '''Humvee 2''' is a khaki-colored and typical in appearance to other Humvees in real life. It has a bullbar on the front, with barbed wire attached to it. It has black windshields, black antennas near the back of the vehicle, black wheels and yellow headlights. == Skins == {| class="light-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" ! |[[File:ClassicHumvee2.png|175px]] |[[File:WastelandHumvee2.png|175px]] |[[File:CyberHumvee2.png|175px]] |[[File:Base1776Humvee2.png|175px]] |- !Skin |{{Color|Premium|Classic}} |{{Color|Hexscape|Wasteland}} |{{Color|Deluxe|Cyber}} |{{Color|Patriotic|Base 1776}} |- !Obtained From |[[Premium Crate]] |[[Hexscape Event#Hexscape Event Battle Pass|Hexscape Event Premium Battle Pass]] |[[Deluxe Crate]] |''🦅 Eagle Screech'' [[Mission Quests|Mission Quest]],
[[Patriotic Crate]] |- ! |[[File:IceCreamHumvee.png|175px]] |[[File:PirateHumvee2.png|175px]] |- !Skin |{{Color|Beach|Ice Cream}} |{{Color|Pirate|Pirate}} |- !Obtained From |[[Beach Crate]] |[[Pirate Crate]] |} == Strategy == *The '''Humvee 2''' is great for high health enemies that spawn early on during the game, like the [[Normal Boss]] or [[Elite Abnormal]]. **It is also somewhat great against [[Hidden]]s if none of your other towers have hidden detection. ***The '''Humvee 2''' cannot collide with [[Ghost (Attribute)|Ghost]] [[enemies]], like the [[Soul]].alth. *On two-pathed maps, only one '''Humvee 2''' will spawn per Level 2 [[Military Base]]. It will go down a random path. *The '''Humvee 2''' can deal full collision damage to enemies with defense, like the [[Heavy]] or [[Elite Abnormal]]. *The '''Humvee 2''' will struggle against any enemy with abilities that damage units because of its low health. **For example, if the [[Fallen King]] uses its ''Sword Swing'' attack, and a '''Humvee 2''' is caught in the attack, it will be instantly destroyed. == Trivia == *The '''Humvee 2''' is based on the [[wp:Humvee|military vehicle of the same name]] made by AM General, as evidenced by its similar design and same name. *While the '''Humvee 2''' has a range of 5, it cannot deal any form of damage, aside from collision damage. *Initially, the [[Truck2]] was named the ''Humvee2'' when it was added, even though it was not similar to a Humvee vehicle in any way. **Interestingly, the '''Humvee 2''' directly replaced the [[Truck2]]. == Update History == {{scroll|text = *'''13 October 2019''' -
